description: This file defines the class FlexibleMapAccessor, which provides flexible access and modification methods for nested maps, supporting dot and bracket syntax for accessing sub-elements within maps and lists. It handles caching of expressions, localization, and various map operations.

classes.name: FlexibleMapAccessor
classes.description: A utility class for flexible, expression-based access and modification of Map data structures, supporting nested expressions and various syntax conventions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FlexibleMapAccessor based on the original expression string, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: containsNestedExpression
methods.description: Indicates whether this accessor contains a nested expression (e.g., dot notation).

methods.name: getOriginalName
methods.description: Returns the original expression string used to create this accessor.

methods.name: getIsAscending
methods.description: Indicates the sort order direction specified by the expression.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the expression or accessor is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a value from the map based on the expression, optionally considering locale for localized maps.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Set a value in the map at the position specified by the expression.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove a value from the map based on the expression.
